result.summary: The page is mostly visually intact, but there is one obvious problem: a loading spinner is still overlaid on the ramen restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, making the content look unfinished.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is persistently displayed over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar food image, even though the image appears to have loaded. This obscures the photo and gives the impression the card is still loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image has finished loading, or replace it with a skeleton placeholder that disappears when content is ready.
